reader.reads: Read the German 1813 Cotta printing beside the register readings, with the 1792 Wikisource transcription.

title.en: On the Ground of Pleasure in Tragic Objects

thesis.ru: При виде Хюона и Аманды переживание победной силы нравственного закона есть столь великое, столь существенное благо, что возникает даже искушение примириться со злом, которому оно обязано.
thesis.en: In seeing Hüon and Amanda, the experience of the victorious power of the moral law is so great, so essential a good that we are even tempted to reconcile ourselves to the evil to which we owe it.

conceptions.note: The register states a general negative claim; this example describes the experience of moral law as a good amid evil.

thesis.ru: Тронутость в строгом смысле обозначает смешанное чувство страдания и удовольствия от страдания.
thesis.en: Being moved, in the strict sense, denotes the mixed feeling of suffering and pleasure in suffering.

conceptions.note: The cited definition speaks of Rührung, suffering and pleasure in suffering; it does not itself identify that pleasure as tragic pleasure.

thesis.ru: Чувство нравственной целесообразности лежит в основании трагической тронутости и нашего удовольствия от страдания.
thesis.en: The feeling of moral purposiveness lies at the foundation of tragic emotion and our pleasure in suffering.

conceptions.note: The register says tragic pleasure is not reducible to pleasant suffering; the sentence specifies a common ground for tragic emotion and pleasure in suffering.

left.reason: The second reader (second-2026-11-12-schiller-tragic-pleasure) does not confirm tragic-pleasure:shares-a-moral-ground-with-pleasure-in:suffering, or its ground is disputed: Page 161 says that the feeling of moral purposiveness lies at the ground of ‘der tragischen Rührung und unserer Lust an dem Leiden’; page 154 calls the experience of the moral law a good in the particular sight of Hüon and Amanda. Neither place states the proposed common ground of tragic pleasure generally and pleasure in suffering: tragic emotion and tragic pleasure are not named as the same thing in these places.

verb.ru: разделяет нравственное основание с удовольствием от
verb.en: shares a moral ground with pleasure in

disputed.note: The page 154 example grounds pleasure in the experience of moral law and explicitly calls that moral purposiveness; page 161 names moral purposiveness as the ground of tragic emotion and pleasure in suffering. Their relation is reconstructed without equating tragic pleasure with pleasure in suffering.
